extraction.policy_summary: TCS states it has a 'Disability Inclusion (Equal Opportunity) policy as per the RPwD Act 2016,' which 'adds on to the impact of TCS Global Diversity, Equity & Inclusion policy and the Tata Code of Conduct' (public link to the Tata Code of Conduct provided; no separate direct link to the disability policy text given).
extraction.pwd_employee_count_details: FY2026: 1,082 total differently abled employees (1,069 permanent + 13 other than permanent) out of 6,17,437 total employees (~0.18%); of these, 796 (73.6%) male and 286 (26.4%) female. Figures are based on voluntary disclosure by employees; 'differently abled includes hearing, visual, locomotor, orthopedic and others.'
extraction.physical_accessibility_measures: In response to the mandated RPwD Act 2016 question, TCS states: 'Yes. All TCS-owned premises have accessibility provided as per the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 (RPwD Act 2016)' for employees, and separately 'Yes. All TCS-owned premises are accessible to differently abled visitors, as per the RPwD Act, 2016.'
extraction.compliance_details: TCS gives unqualified 'Yes' answers to both mandated RPwD Act 2016 questions: that all TCS-owned premises are accessible to differently abled employees, and separately that all TCS-owned premises are accessible to differently abled visitors, 'as per the RPwD Act, 2016.' It also confirms it has a Disability Inclusion (Equal Opportunity) policy as per the RPwD Act 2016. No RPwD Act statutory hiring-quota attainment percentage or WCAG conformance level is stated.
